literal: Those who desire their wife glorious benefit will not attain; those who desire action an undesired thing indeed is that.
translation: Those who are infatuated with their wives will not attain great achievements; such infatuation is also an undesired thing for those who desire to accomplish great deeds.
modern: மனைவியை மட்டுமே விரும்பி அவளது வழி நடப்பவர்கள் சிறந்த நன்மைகளை அடைய மாட்டார்கள்; செயல்களைச் செய்து முடிக்க விரும்புகிறவர்களுக்கும் அது வேண்டத்தகாத ஒரு செயலாகும்.
explanation: This couplet warns against being overly infatuated with one's wife to the neglect of one's duties. The poet states that those who are consumed by domestic infatuation ('மனைவிழைவார்') will fail to achieve great and glorious results ('மாண்பயன் எய்தார்') in life. Furthermore, for those who are dedicated to accomplishing great deeds ('வினைவிழையார்'), such submissiveness is an undesirable trait ('வேண்டாப் பொருள்'). The verse emphasizes that greatness requires focus on duty rather than being ruled by domestic desires.
